sdp_budget_evaluation.replay_margin: replay is 47.6x faster than the SDP budget; well within Phase 0 acceptance
sdp_budget_evaluation.insert_note: the SDP does not state a numerical insert-time budget for Phase 0 (the budget applies to replay); a Phase 1+ 5-min insert budget is implied by the 17k events/s throughput stated in the README. On this aarch64 box the insert is 9m6s, missing the 5-min implied budget by 1.82x. This is recorded as an open gap (see workflows/paper-run/gaps.md AP-26) — NOT silently loosened.

comparison_to_x86_64_priors.comment: the aarch64 single-thread measurement is slightly faster than the x86_64 number recorded in the README on insert (546 vs 565 s) and within noise on replay (6.30 vs 6.4 s). The prior x86_64 number was a single prior-session measurement; the aarch64 number is a fresh measurement in this session. Both fit in the same order of magnitude and confirm the SQLite-on-event-log design scales to 10M events on a single thread.
